To subtract $4$ from $0,$ we start at $0$ on the number line and move $4$ places to the left.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132866/assets/0b52e781b6de8144eef5248de1941ea102834b77ec9ec07a9c266fd395b2b0e8.png)

When we do this, we land at $-4.$ Therefore, $0-4 = -4.$
